window_scopes.unprefixed_features_and_video_start_end: full answer only, retained from schema 1; answer_start/end are explicit aliases
window_scopes.episode_: question start through answer end, excluding earlier rest and earlier answers
window_scopes.question_: linked interviewer question, clipped before answer onset and after earlier rest/respondent speech
window_scopes.waiting_: question end to answer onset; absent when timings overlap, zero duration when immediately adjacent
window_scopes.speech_: respondent speech in the full answer only; internal pauses included in answer duration
window_scopes.delta_answer_minus_question_: answer feature minus question feature, only when both are available
window_scopes.question_start_end_seconds: original linked question bounds; question_phase_start/end are actual measured bounds

research_notes: Split training and evaluation by participant_id. IDs, labels, source_annotation_ids and timing are not predictive features.
Text and question content can disclose the interview protocol; assess text features separately to avoid target leakage.
dataset_eligible means a reviewed target, not validated physiology. Filter features by sync_status and coverage.
HRV requires at least 120 seconds and sufficient usable beats. Short answers retain missing HRV.
Each rPPG value only uses windows fully inside its own phase; unrestricted context rPPG is excluded.
GSR=100000 throughout the interval is unavailable. Channel coverage counts finite usable samples, not detector accuracy.
Pauses may be incompletely annotated. Full answer duration always includes elapsed internal silence.
Values are unrounded and not normalized to baseline. Baseline intervals and markers are in this metadata.
Question/waiting physiology describes context associated with the answer; the interviewer and waiting are not independently labelled truth/lie.
Epochs end at answer end. Post-answer silence and the next question are not added. Earlier rest is excluded.

important_limitations: Ответы и границы частично восстановлены из транскрипции с ошибками; вручную перепроверить интервалы по видео.
BioRadio синхронизирован по одной приблизительной опорной точке с предполагаемым постоянным сдвигом -0.44 с; возможный дрейф часов неизвестен.
GSR постоянно равен 100000 и правильно отражён как недоступный; 10 повреждённых строк импорта и отдельные коды невалидных HR/SpO2 требуют внимания.
Видео/движения/rPPG не включены в итоговые признаки, потому что точная tracked обработка не завершилась, а статический ROI-метод не эквивалентен алгоритму остальных участников.
Эта выгрузка является предварительной; не использовать как окончательно валидированную выборку без проверки временных границ.
